name: Moon Water Palace — interior surfaces and fittings
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Pearl onion dome on a square hall; four tall slender corner minarets and smaller flanking domes; pointed/cusped arches, gold filigree, ivory lattice screens; axial reflecting pool and lateral lotus beds. Small plan suggests central enclosed hall with side courts; isometric fronts a long water court. Hidden layout inference: Water-facing south approach ends at central stair/ghat, then shaded perimeter arcades; keep water court distinct from enclosed hall, place planted land pockets outside pool edges. Rear entrance/service geometry inferred, not a new playable kitchen/service wing. Preserve this local design. Exactly16 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B02-INNER-DETAIL-001 — Moon Water Palace — interior surfaces and fittings". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing Moon Palace interior patterns and join fittings, not another exterior kit
